# Wits AHEAD Research Group

> Wits AHEAD is the Wits Research Group for Advancing Human Capabilities through Education, Analytics and Development, in the Wits School of Education, University of the Witwatersrand, Johannesburg. It studies how artificial intelligence, analytics and data can serve human capability in higher education, with a Global South perspective. Director: Professor Emmanuel Ojo. Contact: Ask@WitsAHEAD.org.

The site is published in six editions: English (/), French (/fr/), Spanish (/es/), Portuguese (/pt/), Chinese (/zh/) and isiZulu (/zu/). Every page exists in every edition at the same path under the language prefix.

## Pages
- [Wits AHEAD Research Group](https://witsahead.org/): Wits AHEAD, the Wits Research Group for Advancing Human Capabilities through Education, Analytics and Development, Wits School of Education, University of the Witwatersrand. AI, analytics and data for human capability in higher education.
- [News and insights](https://witsahead.org/news/): Daily briefing on AI, data and human capability in higher education: news, research, video and readings, curated every morning by Wits AHEAD.
- [The AHEAD Fortnightly](https://witsahead.org/newsletter/): The AHEAD Fortnightly: a free two-page newsletter every second Thursday from Wits AHEAD, signed by the Director. Subscribe, read online or download the PDF.
- [Latest from the group](https://witsahead.org/latest/): The latest supervision, research and website developments at Wits AHEAD, Wits School of Education.
- [About Wits AHEAD](https://witsahead.org/about/): What AHEAD stands for: the mission, remit and complementary place of Wits AHEAD within the Wits School of Education, University of the Witwatersrand.
- [Research pillars](https://witsahead.org/research/): Six research pillars of Wits AHEAD: generative AI in higher education, student success analytics, STEM and teacher education, graduate capability and just transitions, data for education systems, responsible AI.
- [People](https://witsahead.org/people/): The Director, core researchers, affiliates and postdoctoral fellow of Wits AHEAD, Wits School of Education.
- [Supervision](https://witsahead.org/supervision/): The Wits AHEAD supervision board: postgraduate candidates by degree and research theme on the milestone pathway, with no personal data.
- [Global footprint](https://witsahead.org/footprint/): A living map of two decades of Wits AHEAD relationships: funded projects, fellowships, visiting positions and partnerships across 16 countries.
- [Work with us](https://witsahead.org/join/): Wits AHEAD is open to postdoctoral fellows, PhD candidates aligned to its remit, partnerships and research affiliations across the Global North and South. How to get in touch.
- [AHEAD Pathway](https://witsahead.org/pathway/): AHEAD Pathway is the private supervision workspace for postgraduate candidates supervised by the Director of Wits AHEAD: sign in with your university email to keep your record, upload documents and receive feedback.
- [Research projects](https://witsahead.org/projects/): Wits AHEAD research projects: small teams around a question, each with a public page and a private team workspace. First: gamified learning and diversified assessment in metallurgical engineering at Wits.
- [Gamified learning in metallurgical engineering](https://witsahead.org/projects/gamification/): A CheMet and Wits AHEAD study of gamified learning and diversified assessment in metallurgical engineering at Wits, with a living feed of how engineering is taught with games around the world.
- [PASS: predictive analytics for student success](https://witsahead.org/projects/pass/): PASS, an Emory University and Wits collaboration on predictive analytics for student retention and timely graduation, funded by the Halle Institute for Global Research and Wits Collaborative Research Grant 2024.
- [ENABLE: research management as research infrastructure](https://witsahead.org/projects/enable/): ENABLE, a Wits AHEAD project with SARIMA, the Southern African Research & Innovation Management Association, on research management as research infrastructure in African universities: a six-dimension ecosystem model, a multi-country study across Southern Africa, short courses and a costed capacity component inside research grants.
- [Erasmus+ mobility with Aix-Marseille](https://witsahead.org/projects/erasmus/): An Erasmus+ KA171 mobility partnership between the Wits School of Education and Aix-Marseille University, selected in September 2026: master's, doctoral, academic and staff mobility around multilingual teacher education and sustainable development.
- [Follow AHEAD](https://witsahead.org/follow/): Follow Wits AHEAD: install the site as an app on your phone, subscribe to the Fortnightly, the daily briefing and project feeds, add the calendar.
- [Privacy](https://witsahead.org/privacy/): How the Wits AHEAD website handles personal information under the Protection of Personal Information Act.
